svg.title: Supreme Court rejects bid to set aside 20,000 California ballots
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration in a split composition at night. On the left, the floodlit marble west front of the U.S. Supreme Court, with its wide steps, columned portico and pediment, rises against a large pale moon. A ribbon of blank white mail-ballot envelopes sweeps past the steps and across a diagonal divide into a warmly lit California ballot-processing room, where generic election workers sort envelopes in trays at a long table. The envelope ribbon is symbolic. No justices, no text.
